jp:
Suddenly appearing, it attacked
the survey team — a mystery monster
with black-crown horns.

We investigators studied the black stele
fragments that drifted in with its arrival,
and read its identity from the inscription.

「the loathed mad king
who wears the black crown, Morudomunto」

「Its wings devour all creation,
its madness rains spears
that pierce the earth.」

As the inscription says, with
otherworldly wings and black spears
it ravages the Isles.

As one who has studied the Isles for years,
I cannot overlook this ruin.

Explorers, I command you
as chief of the survey.

<CV 10,12>Slay the black-crowned mad king
that menaces the Isles!
